featureShowcases.heading: Keep Your Studio Data Up to Date
featureShowcases.summary: Let StudioDash keep connected services updated in the background on your Mac.
featureShowcases.body: StudioDash is designed to reduce the time spent manually checking different developer and business services. Background synchronisation on Mac keeps supported provider data updated automatically, while clear status information shows which services are working normally and which may need your attention.
bullets: Keep supported provider data updated automatically on Mac.
See when your connected services were last updated.
Check which providers are healthy or need attention.
Refresh data manually whenever you want the latest available information.

image.caption: Keep track of connected services and their latest data from one place.

sections.heading: Background Synchronisation on Mac
paragraphs: StudioDash can keep supported provider data updated in the background on your Mac, reducing the need to open every service and request updates manually.

Each connected service is updated when appropriate rather than every provider being contacted continuously. This helps StudioDash maintain useful, current information while avoiding unnecessary requests to external services.
Background synchronisation is designed to make StudioDash more useful when you return to it: much of the information you need can already be waiting for you.

sections.heading: Know When Your Data Was Updated
paragraphs: StudioDash makes synchronisation visible rather than leaving you to guess whether the information on screen is current. You can see the state of your connected services and identify providers that have updated successfully or need attention.
This is especially useful when your dashboard combines information from several services, because each provider may publish or refresh its data at different times.
bullets: See the status of connected providers.
Identify services that have synchronised successfully.
Understand when information may be waiting for a provider to publish new data.

sections.heading: Provider Health at a Glance
paragraphs: When several services contribute to your dashboard, it is important to know whether they are all working normally. StudioDash provides clear provider health information so problems do not disappear behind incomplete charts or missing totals.
If a connected service needs attention, StudioDash helps distinguish that situation from a period where the provider simply has no new information available.
bullets: Quickly see which connected services are working normally.
Recognise providers that still need to be configured.
Separate connection problems from periods with no new data.

sections.heading: Refresh When You Need To
paragraphs: Automatic updates do not remove your control. StudioDash also lets you request fresh information when you need it, such as after publishing an app, checking recent revenue or investigating a change in performance.
You can refresh connected data without waiting for the next background update, giving you a straightforward way to check for newly available information.

sections.heading: Fast Access to Your Existing Data
paragraphs: StudioDash keeps previously collected information available locally so dashboards and historical reports do not need to download everything again whenever you change a date range or move between views.
This makes everyday navigation faster and allows StudioDash to build useful historical views from information that has already been collected.

sections.heading: One Dashboard, Different Update Schedules
paragraphs: App stores, advertising platforms, analytics services and website providers do not all update their information at the same time. Some information can change frequently, while other reports may only become available periodically.
StudioDash handles these services independently so one provider waiting for new information does not prevent the rest of your dashboard from remaining useful.

sections.heading: Designed Around Your Studio Workflow
paragraphs: StudioDash is designed to make your collected information useful across your workflow while taking advantage of the capabilities available on each platform.

On Mac, background synchronisation can keep supported provider information updated without requiring StudioDash to remain your active workspace. Manual synchronisation remains available when you want to request fresh information yourself.

sections.heading: Your Connections Stay Under Your Control
paragraphs: Synchronisation relies on the services you choose to connect to StudioDash. You remain in control of those integrations and can review their status from within the app.
StudioDash is designed to handle credentials and provider access carefully while giving you clear visibility into the services contributing information to your dashboard.
